device.model: Aubo i5 with AG95 gripper in MuJoCo
device.name: manipulator-mujoco Aubo i5 + AG95 (Gymnasium)

facts.text: AuboI5Env is declared as a gymnasium.Env subclass
AuboI5Env is registered as manipulator_mujoco/AuboI5Env-v0 with entry point manipulator_mujoco.envs:AuboI5Env
The second environment of the package is registered as manipulator_mujoco/UR5eEnv-v0 with entry point manipulator_mujoco.envs:UR5eEnv
The observation space is a Box of shape (6,) with -inf and +inf float64 bounds
The action space is a Box of shape (6,) with every element bounded by -0.1 and 0.1 (float64)
The environment builds a StandardArena, a mocap Target, an AuboI5 arm, an AG95 gripper attached to the arm and a box with 0.02 m half-extents attached as a free body, then creates the physics
AuboI5Env hands the OSC min_effort -150.0, max_effort 150.0, kp 300, ko 300, kv 30, vmax_xyz 1.0 and vmax_abg 2.0
The operational-space controller computes the task-space command and adds gravity compensation before passing the joint effort to the effort controller
The joint effort controller clips every commanded effort to [min_effort, max_effort] and writes it to the joints' qfrc_applied
The arena sets the physics timestep to 0.002 s on the MJCF option
The environment stores the physics model's opt.timestep as its own step interval
The Aubo i5 model bounds each of its six joints to -3.04 to 3.04 rad
The AG95 model gives its joints and the fingers actuator a joint range and ctrlrange of 0 to 0.943 and a forcerange of -5 to 5
The AG95 fingers_actuator is a general actuator driven by the split tendon of the two outer knuckle joints
The ag95/scene.xml file includes ag95.xml and adds a free box with 0.015 m half-extents tied to an anchor by a spatial tendon limited to 0 to 0.02 m

reset(seed, options) calls super().reset(seed=seed), sets the six arm joints to the qpos [0, 0, 1.5707, 0, 1.5707, 0], places the mocap target at [0.5, 0, 0.04] with quaternion [0, 0, 0, 1] and returns the observation and the info dict from _get_info()
_get_obs returns np.zeros(6) and _get_info returns an empty dict
step(action) does not read its action argument: it takes the current mocap target pose, runs the OSC toward it and steps the physics once
step returns the observation, reward 0, terminated False, truncated False and the info dict
Neither registered environment id sets max_episode_steps; the two register calls pass only id and entry_point and both max_episode_steps lines are commented out
render returns physics.render() when render_mode is rgb_array, and close closes the viewer if one was launched

determinism.notes: reset(seed=...) and cap.world.seed.v1 accept a non-negative seed and the bridge records it; the fake is deterministic (the observation is the constant zeros(6) the upstream _get_obs returns) and no random draw changes it, so two runs with the same seed and commands repeat

gaps: the fake backend is a pure Python stand-in for the MuJoCo environment: it mirrors the public env API and the two spaces, keeps a tick counter and returns the observation the upstream _get_obs returns; it integrates no rigid-body, contact, tendon or actuator dynamics and does not run the OSC
the upstream step ignores its action argument, so the published action space changes no modelled state in this build; the bridge still enforces every action bound before calling the environment
the observation is the constant zeros(6) of _get_obs, so joint positions, velocities, contacts, render frames and the mocap pose are not published; the observation space is unbounded (-inf/+inf)
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, the 2 ms timestep is the upstream arena setting and the fake does not integrate simulated time, only the bridge tick count advances
no rendering: the upstream rgb_array path calls physics.render(), the fake renders nothing
MuJoCo, dm_control and the upstream package were not installed where the gate ran, so the fake was never compared with the upstream environment; the sim backend (gymnasium.make) was not run
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state pair
no physical Aubo i5 or AG95 is modelled and nothing was validated against hardware

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
